hero.title: {{gradient:AI Automation}} & Agents
hero.subtitle: AI Automation for Business Operations
hero.description: We help businesses identify repetitive processes that can be streamlined with AI, connect automations to existing systems, and add review steps where people need control. Use cases can include lead classification, customer support triage, and document processing to reduce repetitive work and give teams clearer information for decisions.

items.title: Repetitive Process Automation
items.description: Identify routine steps in business workflows that may be handled or assisted by AI.

items.title: Existing System Integration
items.description: Connect workflow steps with the business software and APIs your team already uses.

items.title: AI Agents for Team Workflows
items.description: Apply AI-assisted classification, support triage, and document processing to selected tasks.

items.title: Human Review and Controls
items.description: Include review and approval steps where teams need to check AI-assisted work.

steps.title: Map the Workflow
steps.description: Understand the current process, repetitive tasks, systems, and decisions that need human input.

steps.title: Plan Integrations and Reviews
steps.description: Define the system connections, data access, and review points for the proposed workflow.

steps.title: Build and Test
steps.description: Implement the selected automation and test it against representative business scenarios.

steps.title: Prepare for Operation
steps.description: Document how the workflow runs and where team members can review or manage its output.

cta.title: Discuss an AI Automation Project
cta.description: Tell us about a repetitive business workflow and the systems your team uses.
